title: Slow Braised Beef Shin
subtitle: Long-cooked beef shin in a rich, glossy wine-and-vegetable broth
excerpt: Thick slices of beef shin braised for three hours in stock, red wine vinegar, and aromatics until the collagen melts into a sticky, deeply flavoured sauce. A weekend braise worth the time.
sourceNotes: Long-braised beef shin is found across French, Italian, and British cooking traditions. The cut is rich in collagen, which breaks down over slow cooking to produce a naturally gelatinous sauce without any thickening agents.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze in the braising liquid. Defrost in the fridge overnight and reheat very gently.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook a day ahead. The sauce sets into a jelly overnight; reheat slowly and it becomes silky again.

content.text: The lower and slower the braise, the more collagen dissolves into the sauce; do not rush the final hour.
Heat the oil in the stockpot over a high heat. Season the beef generously.
Brown the beef in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deeply caramelised. Set aside.
Lower the heat. Add the onion, carrot, and celery. Cook for 5 minutes until starting to colour.
Add the garlic and tomato puree. Stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the red wine vinegar. Stir and let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Return the beef to the pot. Add the stock, worcestershire sauce, thyme, bay leaves, and star anise.
Bring to the boil, then reduce to the lowest simmer. Cover tightly.
Cook for 2.5 to 3 hours, turning the beef once at the halfway point.
The beef is ready when it yields easily when pressed with a spoon.
Remove the herbs and star anise. Taste the sauce and season. Serve with mashed potato or polenta.

items.symptom: Sauce is very thin after 3 hours.
items.cause: Lid held in too much steam.
items.fix: Remove beef; boil sauce hard for 10 minutes until it coats a spoon.

items.symptom: Beef is still tough at 2.5 hours.
items.cause: Shin pieces were very thick or heat too low.
items.fix: Cover and continue braising; it will eventually yield.

items.cause: Red wine vinegar was not fully cooked out.
items.fix: Simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes to mellow the acidity.
